title: Constructibility of the geometrically irreducible fibre locus
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a finitely presented homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. For every prime $\mathfrak p$ of $A$ let $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ be its residue field [def-weil-residue-field]. The subset
$$E_{\mathrm{irr}}(B/A)=\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}A\mid \operatorname{Spec}(B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p))\text{ is geometrically irreducible over }\kappa(\mathfrak p)\}$$
is constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset]. The spectrum is [def-weil-affine-spectrum]; geometric irreducibility means irreducibility and nonemptiness after every field extension [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. No flatness or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed on $A\to B$.

source.place: Tag 055B (lemma-nr-geom-irreducible-components-constructible), level n=1, affine ring form; the geometric fibre is Noetherian since it is of finite type over a field, so having one geometric irreducible component is precisely geometric irreducibility. Local constructibility on the affine base gives constructibility by Properties Tag 054C (lemma-locally-constructible).

mathlib_searches.query: The geometrically irreducible fibre locus of a finitely presented algebra is constructible and commutes with arbitrary change of base ring
mathlib_searches.results: Chevalley constructible images and constructible-set data maps, not constructibility of the geometric fibre locus.

mathlib_searches.query: The set of primes with geometrically irreducible fibre of a finitely presented ring homomorphism is constructible
mathlib_searches.results: PrimeSpectrum.isConstructible_range_comap, isConstructible_comap_image and constructible-set data; irreducibility of a domain spectrum. No geometric fibre-locus theorem.

Read Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Geometrically/Irreducible.lean and Integral.lean: definitions, fibre criteria and base-change stability, but no constructible fibre locus. Grep restricted to AlgebraicGeometry.

mathlib_searches.query: For a finite presentation morphism of affine schemes the loci of geometrically reduced and geometrically irreducible fibres are locally constructible
mathlib_searches.results: Chevalley image/preimage constructibility, LocallyOfFinitePresentation and fibre Jacobson instances; none asserts constructibility of geometric fibre loci.
Only GroupTheory/Coset/Card.lean:67 (wikidata Q505798, an unrelated numeric substring). No geometric fibre-locus theorem.

from.place: Proof (1)--(2), semistable-alteration input: the Raynaud--Gruson flattening argument uses Stacks 05I3 for universal injectivity and equivalence of flatness with the cokernel, globalized by Algebra 05CL; within 05I3 (1)⇒(2), the projectivity of S over R (Tag 05FT) used with Tag 05FQ. In the resulting 05FT Noetherian-approximation input: 05FH, good irreducible-fibre locus.
